profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Distributed Systems & Event-Driven Architecture | AWS | FinTech @ Scalable Capital
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 20+ years of experience in distributed systems and cloud-native architectures.
At Scalable Capital, I build and operate event-driven investment and banking systems at scale in a regulated FinTech environment.
Experienced in system design, modernization, and the evolution of business-critical platforms on AWS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working on core backend systems for a FinTech platform, focusing on distributed systems and event-driven architectures on AWS.

• Transitioned core workflows from synchronous to asynchronous processing to improve scalability and reliability  
• Reduced batch processing time from hours to minutes  
• Involved in production support and cross-team infrastructure changes  

Tech: Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, AWS, MySQL, Terraform
